## 2. Avoid

- **Also avoid:** Vendor-awarded 'Fractional CAIO' certificates (avoid per T0-68 G4; 0 independent employer standing); over-promising full-time build output on a 1-day/week retainer

## 3. Types that do not apply

- **Framework / SDK:** framework syntax is delegated to client or contract engineers
- **Library / package:** libraries are delegated to engineering
- **Data store:** database engineering is delegated to engineering
- **Infrastructure / DevOps tool:** infrastructure tools are delegated to engineering
- **Specialised product:** specific SaaS/eval tools follow client vendor selection
- **Hardware / accelerator:** hardware engineering is not expected
- **Protocol / standard:** protocol implementation is delegated to engineering
- **Research craft:** original research is not expected

## 4. Credentials (tie-breakers, not skills)

- **Optional:** IAPP Artificial Intelligence Governance Professional (AIGP): Optional governance signal for regulated mid-market retainers (CAIO cert nice-to-have in 1/13 T0-66; 6.6% GRC Careers, 8.9% Axial) [B/C · T0-34, T0-66 L600] [T0-34, T0-66]

## 5. Prerequisites and proof

- **Prerequisites:** Prior Head of AI, VP, CTO or C-suite leadership seat (explicit in 9/13 T0-66 postings, L588); client pipeline via executive network or PE/VC operating-partner referrals (53-75% referral share in independent surveys vs 92% Go Fractional vendor claim, T0-66).
- **Proof to show:** 2-3 anonymised executive case studies showing AI strategy -> shipped pilot -> measurable ROI, governance policy templates deployed, and permanent hires or vendor contracts structured.
- **Posting terms (measured or cited):** Fractional CAIO, Fractional Head of AI, AI strategy, AI governance, ROI, executive communication, change management, vendor selection, PE/SMB AI transformation.
